brief.premise: 沿岸の小さな漁村で、潮が引くたびに灯りが消える。

world.name: 灯の浜
world.description: A fishing village in which the lamps go out whenever the tide falls.

locations.name: 灯の浜 (Tomoshibi Beach)
locations.description: A pebble beach where the village keeps its lamps.

rules.statement: The lamps go out whenever the tide falls and are relit when it returns.

history.name: The First Ebb
history.description: On the first ebb the village's lamps went dark and were relit when the tide returned.

characters.name: Hana (花)
characters.description: A lamp-keeper of Tomoshibi Beach who relights the village's lamps whenever the tide returns.
characters.motivation: To keep the village's lamps burning through every tide.
characters.goal: Relight the lamps at each rising tide.
characters.flaw: Cannot rest while a lamp is dark.
characters.internal_conflict: She wonders why the lamps go out.
characters.external_conflict: The ebb tide puts the lamps out every day.
characters.arc: Hana learns to rest between tides.

evidence_summary: A minimal, mixed-language cast with no abilities, faction or relationships, in a minimal world with no constraints.
